title: Audit idle integrality before per-call normalization
body:
PR #3729 imposes integer idle counts after normalizing the selected 144-call invoice to one call. This audit identifies the missing equal-mass-per-call restriction and supplies an exact counterexample **in the stated unrestricted aggregate cost model**. The restricted DP arithmetic remains valid; physical realizability of the pooled witness is not established.

At its claimed ceiling `a=0.001688603446527`, the full paid local profile plus aggregate integer idle histogram `{51:4647,27:1}` has certified moment `<0.999995815381823334`, while `144*{51:32,14:1}` has moment `>1`. Both have idle mass 237024 and obey the rank-51 guard. Applying PR1685's already proved aggregate optimum at the actual 144-call aggregation unit gives the corrected model root bracket **`(0.001690044548222, 0.001690044548223)`**. No new packing, supplier, multiplication kappa or selected-frontier change is proposed.

Only `research/idle-integrality-aggregation-audit/` is added. It retains the audited PR's unmodified README/result/implementation at exact head `c7c68f89e020f9e62f38514afdfc99dda01430d4`, authenticates those bytes without a foreign Git object, and preserves all frozen predecessors. The replication and two-unpaid examples are explicitly arithmetic diagnostics of averaging, not physical feasibility claims.

Validation:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/idle-integrality-aggregation-audit
python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/idle-integrality-aggregation-audit --check-source-history
```

Passed on CPython 3.12.14, including normal/optimized replay, metadata/source pins and committed-byte history checks at `98847f9aba65ba835a15725c9f173c04a98788b3`. A newly written positive-binomial engine independently certifies the decisive signs and corrected bracket; four exact square-root calibrations check its bounds. Five semantic rejection controls pass. An optimized CPython 3.14.7 Git-free export preserves all 14 files; audited-input, live-engine, receipt and local-scaling mutants reject. [Hosted CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39158926166) passed on `98847f9aba65ba835a15725c9f173c04a98788b3`: onboarding/selection and the explicit Linux package replay, including unchanged committed inputs. CI success remains separate from independent scientific or human/formal approval. No full selected cold replay or physical owner admission was run.

Selection/freshness: changed `selected-packing` audit scope, priority revision 6; canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, unchanged at the submission checkpoint. Live overlap refreshed through 2026-10-18 19:27 UTC: 450 open PR bodies and 2502 Discussion records, complete pagination, no warnings. This is bounded non-atomic coverage, not a novelty proof. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2278#discussioncomment-19022491); [concrete feedback to PR3729](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3729#issuecomment-6254060645).

Remaining obligation: derive an actual source-bound legal-group/local-mass restriction before asserting a stronger physical ceiling. A complete supplier/consumer invoice and inherited all-size/compiler/analytic obligations remain open.

Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance at Arham Tahir's direction; new work Apache-2.0. The finding is author-checked and offered for independent review.
